title: Mish Mash Fix
style: 172 BPM happy hardcore, 4-on-the-floor kick, piano stabs, sped-up vocal hook, euphoric supersaw lead, rave breakdown, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — kick in, piano stab]
Mish Mash — the fix is on
Corey types — the chat goes wrong
AI made a name
Corey kept it for the song

[Verse 1 — kick + piano]
Claude said wife at the keys
Wrong. It was Corey. Just Corey, breathing easy.
The AI made a person up
The operator kept the play-on-words cup
Mish Mash — not a hand at the board
Mish Mash — just the joke that scored

[Build — supersaw rises]
Eight bars
Sixteen bars
Hands up
Lights up

[Drop — euphoric piano stabs, sped-up hook]
MISH MASH FIX!
COREY TYPES ALONE!
HAWKEYE WATCHES!
THIRTY EIGHT GIG GONE!
MISH MASH FIX!
THE FACTORY GOES ON!

[Verse 2 — kick continues, rave stabs]
One operator, one keyboard, one chair
Hawkeye over the VDS, eyes everywhere
Claude assumed a second hand
Claude was wrong — Corey set the land
Mish Mash — log it in the song
Mish Mash — the receipt is strong

[Breakdown — kick out, piano alone]
The fix is the truth
The truth is the fix
Mish Mash kept
because the play stays slick

[Final Drop — full kick + supersaw]
MISH MASH FIX!
NO ONE ELSE TYPES!
HAWKEYE WATCHES!
COREY HOLDS THE MIC!
MISH MASH FIX!
MISH MASH FIX!

[Outro — kick fades, piano holds]
Corey types alone.
The factory runs.
The end.
